IntroText: A girl with long red hair stands on the path like she owns the quiet.|She watches you approach. Not friendly. Not unfriendly.
Sidney.|(She offers the name only after she decides you earned it.)
You got the join kit.|(Her eyes go to the rope at your side. Not surprised.)
One of us walks away tied.|(Calm. Certain. Not theatrical.)
You don't have rope on you.|(Almost disappointed.) Fix that — or accept the other way.
—Hey.|(The rope bites. She tests it once, hard.)
You actually committed.|(Breath uneven. Eyes brighter, not softer.)
Don't look so pleased.|(She is not begging. She is cataloguing.)
You finish the knots the other way.|(She rolls her wrists. Does not thank you loudly.)
There.|(Your wrists settle. She checks the tension like practice.)
Standard issue works both ways.|(She steps back to see the whole picture.)
I could leave you like this.|(A pause.) I won't. Not on day one.
The rope is off. The day is not.|(She studies you one last time.)
Go. Sleep. Tomorrow the paths are still open.
